# Dom Pedro: This is how you get the Ghoul Revolver (All Mods)

![Dom Pedro: This is how you get the Ghoul Revolver (All Mods)](/uploads/591_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update April 23, 2026] Construction plans at Windy

You all already know it from the Fallout series Season 1. The Ghoul Revolver was already remarkable back then and we were already wondering whether this revolver would one day make it into the Fallout 76 game. Now with the Burning Springs update on December 2nd, 2025 the time has come. The Ghoul Revolver has been named "Dom Pedro" and will be available as a reward in **Season 23**. 

### Season 23 Reward

As of December 2nd, 2025, **Dom Pedro (the Ghoul Revolver)** will be available as a reward on **page 7** of the pages. The grip mods are available on **page 9**, the slide mods on **page 10** and the magazine mods on **page 11**. There is also a mod listed on **Bonus Page 1**, which probably contains the explosive/penetrating mods. 

### Mini Season Reward/Rifle Butt Mods

In the mini season "Love hurts" Dom Pedro's mods were expanded and we received piston mods in this mini season. These piston mods allow you to convert Dom Pedro into a rifle.

### Availability after the season?

Dom Pedro was unavailable after season 23.

That has now changed, in Patch 67 on April 21st, 2026 the Dom Pedro blueprints for gold were added to Windy's offering in Highway Town.

### Dom Pedro blueprints at Windy

You will only see these blueprints in Windy's offer if you have not unlocked Dom Pedro during the season.

| Construction plan: Dom Pedro | 2000 Gold | 
| Blueprint: Dom Pedro Lock Mods | 750 gold | 
| Blueprint: Dom Pedro Magazine Mods | 750 gold | 
| Blueprint: Dom Pedro Visor Mods | 750 gold | 
| Blueprint: Dom Pedro Grip Mods *Note: Makes Dom Pedro into a revolver* | 750 gold | 
| Blueprint: Dom Pedro Piston Mods 1 *Note: Makes Dom Pedro into a rifle* | 750 gold | 
| Blueprint: Dom Pedro Piston Mods 2 *Note: Makes Dom Pedro into a rifle* | 750 gold | 
| Blueprint: Dom Pedro Explosive Mods | 750 gold | 

### Basic information

Dom Pedro can be crafted at **Level 20/30/40/50**. After crafting, the revolver initially has no legendary effects. You can now “roll” and mount any legendary effects. 1,2,3 and 4 star mods are possible.

Dom Pedro cannot **drop** legendary from events or enemies.

The following mods are available for Dom Pedro:
